name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An AI skill that draws polished, on-brand explainer diagrams (flowcharts, architecture maps, timelines) as clean standalone files — no ugly default chart-tool look.
buyer: A content marketer or technical blogger who needs good-looking diagrams for posts and docs but can't afford a designer for every article.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company's content team generates on-brand architecture and 'how it works' diagrams for blog posts and docs without hiring a designer.
A solo newsletter writer uses it to add professional explainer visuals to every issue, raising perceived quality and sponsor appeal.
An agency offers 'AI-generated branded diagrams' as an add-on service for clients' pitch decks and one-pagers.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'diagram pack' service: clients send rough notes, you deliver 10 branded diagrams using this tool.
Build a hosted SaaS wrapper (upload your brand colors, describe the diagram, get an SVG) and charge per export.

steal_this: Build a simple web form over this skill: brand colors in, plain-English description in, branded SVG diagram out — charge $5 per diagram or $20/mo unlimited.
